shown.message:
I aligned the outline's common-target-set section with `idea-repo`'s Brief rev. 4 and pushed it as Outline rev. 3. Brief rev. 4 adopted that protocol change, so §2b now follows the Brief's details:
- The target set T is about N/3 of the benchmarks, stratified by task type.
- There are at least 50 random pool/target splits per held-out model.
- The k grid is k ≤ ⌊|C|/2⌋, with N/3 kept as the reference on the k/N axis.

The margin aggregation and the source of the temporal split also follow Brief rev. 4.

Nothing else needs action from me. I'm ending the turn here and will wake when results or requests arrive.
